rules.name: PCI-DSS — Unencrypted Cardholder Data Transmission
rules.description: Detects transmission of cardholder data over unencrypted channels violating PCI-DSS Requirement 4
rules.query:
network_traffic_events
| where protocol in ("HTTP", "FTP", "Telnet", "SMTP") and data_classification == "cardholder_data"
| summarize count() by SourceIP, DestinationIP, Protocol, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > 1

rules.name: PCI-DSS — Default Credentials in Cardholder Environment
rules.description: Detects use of default vendor credentials in cardholder data environment violating PCI-DSS Requirement 8
rules.query:
auth_events
| where username in ("admin", "root", "default", "password", "vendor") and environment == "cardholder_data"
| summarize count() by Username, SystemName, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > 3

rules.name: PCI-DSS — Unauthorized Access to Cardholder Data
rules.description: Detects unauthorized access attempts to cardholder data stores violating PCI-DSS Requirement 7
rules.query:
data_access_events
| where data_classification == "cardholder_data" and access_result == "unauthorized"
| summarize count() by SourceIP, UserID, DataStore, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > 3

rules.name: PCI-DSS — Missing MFA for CDE Access
rules.description: Detects access to cardholder data environment without required multi-factor authentication violating PCI-DSS Requirement 8
rules.query:
auth_events
| where environment == "cardholder_data" and mfa_used == false and mfa_required == true
| summarize count() by UserID, SystemName, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > 1

rules.name: PCI-DSS — PAN Displayed in Cleartext
rules.description: Detects primary account numbers displayed in cleartext violating PCI-DSS Requirement 3
rules.query:
data_access_events
| where pan_visible == true and masking_applied == false and environment == "cardholder_data"
| summarize count() by UserID, ApplicationName, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > 1

rules.name: PCI-DSS — Weak Cryptography in CDE
rules.description: Detects use of weak or deprecated cryptographic algorithms in cardholder data environment
rules.query:
encryption_events
| where algorithm in ("DES", "RC4", "MD5", "SHA1", "SSLv3", "TLS1.0", "TLS1.1") and environment == "cardholder_data"
| summarize count() by Algorithm, SystemName, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where count_ > 3

rules.name: PCI-DSS — Wireless Access Point in CDE
rules.description: Detects unauthorized wireless access points in or near cardholder data environment
rules.query:
network_events
| where device_type == "wireless_access_point" and cde_zone == true and authorized == false
| summarize count() by DeviceMAC, ZoneName, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > 1

rules.name: PCI-DSS — Excessive Privileges in CDE
rules.description: Detects users with excessive privileges in cardholder data environment violating least privilege
rules.query:
privilege_events
| where environment == "cardholder_data" and privilege_level in ("admin", "superuser", "root") and least_privilege_violation == true
| summarize count() by UserID, PrivilegeLevel, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where count_ > 3

rules.name: PCI-DSS — Audit Log Tampering in CDE
rules.description: Detects tampering or disabling of audit logs in cardholder data environment
rules.query:
audit_log_events
| where environment == "cardholder_data" and operation_type in ("disable", "delete", "modify", "clear") and authorized == false
| summarize count() by UserID, OperationType, SystemName, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > 1

rules.name: PCI-DSS — SQL Injection Against Payment System
rules.description: Detects SQL injection attacks targeting payment processing systems
rules.query:
let sqli_patterns = dynamic(["' OR 1=1", "' UNION SELECT", "'; DROP TABLE", "'--", "1=1", "exec(", "xp_cmdshell"]);
application_logs
| where environment == "cardholder_data" and (request_query has_any (sqli_patterns) or request_body has_any (sqli_patterns))
| summarize count() by SourceIP, ApplicationName, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > 2

rules.name: PCI-DSS — Payment Skimming Detection
rules.description: Detects web skimming or JavaScript injection targeting payment pages
rules.query:
web_application_events
| where page_type == "payment" and script_injection == true or dom_mutation_score > 0.8
| summarize count() by SourceIP, PageURL, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > 1

rules.name: PCI-DSS — Network Segmentation Violation in CDE
rules.description: Detects traffic crossing network segmentation boundaries in cardholder data environment
rules.query:
network_traffic_events
| where source_zone == "cde" and destination_zone != "cde" and traffic_type == "unauthorized"
| summarize count() by SourceIP, DestinationZone, Protocol, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > 3

rules.name: PCI-DSS — Physical Access to CDE Without Badge
rules.description: Detects physical access to cardholder data environment without proper badge or authorization
rules.query:
physical_access_events
| where zone == "cardholder_data" and badge_present == false or authorization == false
| summarize count() by BadgeID, ZoneName, EntryType, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where count_ > 3

rules.name: PCI-DSS — Vulnerability Scanner Disabled in CDE
rules.description: Detects disabling or misconfiguration of vulnerability scanning in cardholder data environment
rules.query:
vulnerability_scanner_events
| where environment == "cardholder_data" and scanner_status in ("disabled", "misconfigured", "offline")
| summarize count() by ScannerName, ZoneName, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where count_ > 1

rules.name: PCI-DSS — Expired SSL/TLS Certificate in CDE
rules.description: Detects expired or expiring SSL/TLS certificates in cardholder data environment
rules.query:
certificate_events
| where environment == "cardholder_data" and (certificate_status == "expired" or days_until_expiry < 30)
| summarize count() by CertificateCN, ExpiryDate, bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| where count_ > 1

rules.name: PCI-DSS — Insecure Data Storage of PAN
rules.description: Detects storage of unencrypted primary account numbers violating PCI-DSS Requirement 3
rules.query:
data_storage_events
| where data_type == "PAN" and encryption_status == "unencrypted" and storage_location != "tokenized"
| summarize count() by StorageLocation, DatabaseName, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > 1

rules.name: PCI-DSS — Malware Protection Disabled in CDE
rules.description: Detects disabled or misconfigured malware protection in cardholder data environment
rules.query:
malware_protection_events
| where environment == "cardholder_data" and protection_status in ("disabled", "outdated", "misconfigured")
| summarize count() by SystemName, ProtectionType, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where count_ > 1

rules.name: PCI-DSS — Failed Penetration Test Remediation
rules.description: Detects failure to remediate vulnerabilities identified in penetration tests within required timeframes
rules.query:
vulnerability_events
| where environment == "cardholder_data" and remediation_status == "overdue" and days_since_discovery > 30
| summarize count() by VulnerabilityID, Severity, bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| where count_ > 3

rules.name: PCI-DSS — Third-Party Remote Access to CDE
rules.description: Detects unauthorized third-party remote access to cardholder data environment
rules.query:
remote_access_events
| where environment == "cardholder_data" and access_type == "third_party" and authorized == false
| summarize count() by VendorName, UserID, AccessType, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where count_ > 1

rules.name: PCI-DSS — Change Control Violation in CDE
rules.description: Detects unauthorized changes to cardholder data environment without proper change control
rules.query:
change_events
| where environment == "cardholder_data" and change_approved == false and change_documented == false
| summarize count() by ChangeType, SystemName, UserID, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where count_ > 3

rules.name: PCI-DSS — Insider Threat Card Data Access Anomaly
rules.description: Detects anomalous access patterns to cardholder data by insiders indicating potential data theft
rules.query:
data_access_events
| where data_classification == "cardholder_data" and access_anomaly_score > 0.8 and user_type == "internal"
| summarize count() by UserID, AccessPattern, bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
| where count_ > 5

rules.name: PCI-DSS — Clock Synchronization Failure in CDE
rules.description: Detects time synchronization failures in cardholder data environment affecting audit log integrity
rules.query:
time_sync_events
| where environment == "cardholder_data" and sync_status == "failed" or time_drift_seconds > 5
| summarize count() by SystemName, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where count_ > 5

rules.name: PCI-DSS — Insecure Password Policy in CDE
rules.description: Detects accounts in cardholder data environment with password policies not meeting PCI-DSS requirements
rules.query:
password_policy_events
| where environment == "cardholder_data" and (min_password_length < 7 or complexity_required == false or history_count < 4)
| summarize count() by PolicyName, SystemName, bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| where count_ > 1

rules.name: PCI-DSS — Data Retention Violation in CDE
rules.description: Detects cardholder data retained beyond required periods or not destroyed properly
rules.query:
data_retention_events
| where environment == "cardholder_data" and (data_age_days > retention_days and data_deleted == false) or destruction_method == "insecure"
| summarize count() by DataCategory, RetentionPolicyDays, bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| where count_ > 5

rules.name: PCI-DSS — Incident Response Plan Gaps in CDE
rules.description: Detects security incidents in cardholder data environment without corresponding incident response plan activation
rules.query:
incident_events
| where environment == "cardholder_data" and severity in ("high", "critical") and ir_plan_activated == false
| summarize count() by IncidentType, Severity, bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
| where count_ > 1
